prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Full bleed layout redesign for pet pick friend screen: Redesign the pick friend screen into an immersive full bleed layout featuring full-screen pet artwork.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion"}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesign the photo upload screen with a focused spotlight layout centered on custom pet photo selection.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Upload Custom Pet Photo"}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive preview flow for adoption certificate: Introduce an interactive pet naming and preview card flow directly on the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "name_input", "label": "Pet Name", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:cert_preview", "style": "large"}]}}
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality preference selection screen: Add a new personality selection screen in the adoption sub-flow to customize pet desktop behaviors before finishing setup.
   config: {"new_personality": {"headline": "Choose Pet Personality", "body": "Select how active and vocal your desktop pet should be on your screen.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_personality", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [adoption, new_flow] Pet color customization sub-flow in friend selection: Add an interactive pet color palette and style selection flow directly within the pick friend screen.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Color Palette", "style": "playful"}]}}
5: [adoption, incentive] Exclusive starter accessory unlock on adoption certificate: Offer a complimentary starter accessory badge when completing the adoption certificate step.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Unlocks Free Starter Item!", "style": "highlight"}]}}
6: [sign_in, hint] Sign-in load delay recovery hint: Add a retry hint on the sign-in screen to assist users if authentication takes longer than usual.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Taking longer than expected? Tap retry or double check your network connection."}}
7: [sign_in, layout] Centered layout redesign for sign-in screen: Switch the sign-in screen to a clean centered layout to eliminate visual distraction during auth.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "centered"}}
8: [finish, layout] Centered layout redesign for home intro screen: Switch the home intro final screen to a centered layout to clearly focus on the final launch action.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "centered"}}
9: [home, hint] Background desktop preparation hint on waiting screen: Display a reassuring hint on the waiting screen explaining that desktop engine initialization runs safely in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Preparing your pet in the background. Your desktop stays responsive while setup finishes."}}
